title: Assistant Manager - Project Execution
description:
**Lead Complex Valve Projects as Assistant Manager – Project Execution**
========================================================================

Are you ready for the next step in your career? Join us as a Senior Engineer / Assistant Manager – Project Execution and play a key role in delivering valve and spare part orders that keep customer operations moving forward. You will review and execute customer contracts, coordinate with suppliers and customers, and drive projects from order receipt to final delivery. In this role, your expertise will help ensure quality, timely execution, and customer satisfaction while working closely with cross\-functional teams. If you enjoy combining engineering knowledge with project management and customer interaction, this could be your next challenge.


**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------

* You will review customer orders against quotations and contractual requirements, ensuring all project, product, and legal requirements are accurately captured.
* You will manage order execution activities, maintain project data in CRM and ERP systems, and ensure customer commitments are met throughout the project lifecycle.
* You will coordinate with customers, suppliers, sales teams, and third\-party inspectors to secure document approvals, inspections, and timely order progress.
* You will monitor project schedules, provide regular progress updates to customers and internal stakeholders, and support shipping and inspection clearances.
* You will collaborate with finance, sales, and customers to facilitate documentation and support on\-time payment collection while maintaining high quality standards.

**Expectations for you**
------------------------

* You hold a B.E. / B.Tech degree, preferably in Mechanical Engineering.
* You have 8\+ years of experience in project management within industrial products, particularly valves.
* You possess knowledge of control valve and actuator sizing and selection, with familiarity in valve applications and ASME codes being advantageous.
* You are proficient in MS Office applications, especially Excel, and have experience working with ERP systems.
* You have strong written and verbal English communication skills along with excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage changing priorities.

**To succeed in this role**
---------------------------

Success in this position requires strong project execution expertise, a solid understanding of valve products and customer contract requirements, and the ability to coordinate effectively across customers, suppliers, inspectors, sales, and finance teams. You should be highly organized, quality\-focused, and capable of managing multiple priorities while ensuring customer commitments are delivered on time.


We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles—practical behaviours that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together:


* Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through
* Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly
* Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety
* Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value

**We offer**
------------

You will become part of the Project Execution function responsible for reviewing, processing, and executing customer orders for valves and spare parts. The team works closely with customers, suppliers, sales, finance, and inspection agencies to ensure projects are delivered with high quality and on schedule. You will have the opportunity to contribute to customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and continuous improvement initiatives while working on technically challenging projects. The role offers broad exposure to project management, engineering practices, customer interactions, and supply chain coordination.


Valmet offers an inspiring and challenging position with opportunities for professional growth and development. Our collaborative and international work environment encourages innovation, continuous learning, and knowledge sharing. We value our employees and provide modern tools, development opportunities, and a supportive workplace culture.


**Want to know more?**
----------------------

Did we catch your interest? We would love to hear from you. For further information about this opportunity, please contact the Hiring Manager or the Talent Acquisition team. Please submit your application through our careers portal before the application closing date specified in the job posting.


**When everything works together**
----------------------------------

*Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting\-edge technologies and services as well as mission\-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow. At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential, never on personal characteristics such as gender, gender identity, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, neurodiversity, religion, sexual orientation, or political views. Join the team – and lead the way with us!*

### **Job Description**


**Key Responsibilities**

 **A. Project Planning \& Execution**

  

* Take complete ownership of assigned digital transformation and MES projects.
* Conduct project kick\-off meetings with internal and customer teams.
* Understand project scope, technical requirements, deliverables and contractual commitments.
* Prepare detailed project execution plans and project schedules.
* Define project milestones, activities, dependencies and resource requirements.
* Establish project governance and review mechanisms.
* Track project progress against approved baseline schedules.
* Ensure timely completion of milestones and deliverables.
* Identify project delays and implement recovery plans.
* Coordinate multiple projects simultaneously wherever required.

 **B. Customer Management**

  

* Act as the primary project\-level contact for customers.
* Conduct regular project review meetings with customer stakeholders.
* Understand customer expectations and resolve project\-related concerns.
* Prepare and present project status reports.
* Manage customer communication related to scope, schedule, risks, issues and dependencies.
* Maintain strong customer relationships throughout the project lifecycle.
* Escalate critical customer issues to management at the appropriate time.
* Ensure customer acceptance and successful project closure.

 **C. Technical Coordination**

  

* Coordinate with software development teams for application development.
* Coordinate with automation teams for PLC, SCADA and machine integration.
* Coordinate with database and infrastructure teams.
* Coordinate ERP/SAP integration activities.
* Review functional and technical specifications.
* Participate in solution architecture discussions.
* Ensure technical deliverables meet project requirements.
* Support technical teams in resolving critical implementation issues.
* Ensure integration between software, hardware, machines and enterprise systems.

  

The Project Manager is not expected to be the primary developer or automation engineer, but should possess sufficient technical knowledge to understand, coordinate and challenge technical decisions effectively.

 **D. Scope \& Change Management**

  

* Establish and maintain the approved project scope.
* Identify scope deviations during execution.
* Evaluate change requests from customers.
* Coordinate technical and commercial impact assessment.
* Maintain Change Request / Change Order documentation.
* Ensure additional work is not executed without proper approval.
* Communicate scope, schedule and cost impacts to stakeholders.
* Support the sales/commercial team in preparing change\-order proposals.

 **E. Resource Management**

  

* Prepare project resource plans.
* Allocate resources based on project priorities.
* Coordinate software developers, BA, QA, automation engineers, technical writers and commissioning engineers.
* Monitor resource utilization.
* Identify resource constraints and resolve conflicts.
* Plan onsite/offsite resource requirements.
* Ensure adequate technical resources are available during critical project phases.

 **F. Risk \& Issue Management**

  

* Identify project risks during planning and execution.
* Maintain a Project Risk Register.
* Define mitigation and contingency plans.
* Monitor technical, commercial, schedule and resource risks.
* Maintain an Issue Log and ensure timely closure.
* Escalate critical risks and issues to management.
* Conduct root\-cause analysis for major project problems.
* Implement preventive actions to avoid recurrence.

 **G. Project Documentation**

  

Ensure timely preparation and maintenance of:

  

* Project Charter
* Project Plan
* Requirement Specification
* Functional Requirement Specification (FRS)
* Technical Specification
* Project Schedule
* Resource Plan
* Risk Register
* Issue Register
* Change Request Register
* Meeting Minutes
* Weekly/Monthly Project Reports
* Test Plans
* FAT/SAT Documentation
* UAT Documentation
* Training Documents
* Deployment Plan
* Go\-Live Plan
* Project Closure Report
* As\-built Documentation

 **H. Testing, Commissioning \& Go\-Live**

  

* Plan and coordinate system testing activities.
* Coordinate SIT, FAT, UAT and SAT activities.
* Ensure defects are tracked and closed.
* Coordinate customer validation and acceptance.
* Prepare deployment and go\-live plans.
* Manage production implementation.
* Coordinate stabilization/support activities after go\-live.
* Ensure final project handover to support/operations teams.

 **I. Commercial \& Financial Responsibility**

  

* Monitor project cost against approved budget.
* Track project profitability and resource utilization.
* Monitor billing milestones and deliverables.
* Coordinate with finance/commercial teams for milestone billing.
* Identify potential cost overruns.
* Support management in project financial reviews.
* Ensure project execution remains commercially viable.

* SQL/NoSQL databases
* API and system integration
* REST APIs
* Authentication and user management

* PLC concepts

### **Manufacturing Systems**

title: Salesforce Functional Project Manager
description:
**10 \-12 Years of Experience**
-------------------------------


### **Location: Coimbatore, Chennai**

  

  

**Job Summary:**
----------------


The Salesforce Functional Project Manager will be responsible for leading Salesforce implementation and enhancement projects from a functional and delivery perspective. This role acts as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring business requirements are clearly defined, translated into functional solutions, and delivered on time, within scope, and with high quality. The role requires strong Salesforce functional expertise, stakeholder management, and project governance skills.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**
----------------------------------


### **Project \& Delivery Management**


* Lead end\-to\-end Salesforce projects including implementations, enhancements, migrations, and integrations.
* Define project scope, objectives, timelines, milestones, and deliverables in alignment with business goals.
* Develop and manage detailed project plans, RAID logs, and status reports.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams including Salesforce Admins, Developers, QA, and external vendors.

### **Business \& Functional Leadership**


* Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document functional requirements.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Validate proposed Salesforce solutions to ensure alignment with business needs and Salesforce best practices.
* Lead functional design workshops, requirement walkthroughs, and solution review sessions.

### **Salesforce Functional Oversight**


* Provide functional leadership across Salesforce clouds such as Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Marketing Cloud (as applicable).
* Ensure proper configuration of Salesforce features including workflows, flows, validation rules, approval processes, reports, and dashboards.
* Oversee data management, data migration, and data quality activities.
* Ensure system usability, scalability, and adoption across user groups.
  

  

### **Stakeholder \& Communication Management**


* Act as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders and senior leadership.
* Provide regular project updates, risks, and mitigation plans to stakeholders.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and resolve functional or delivery\-related conflicts.

### **Quality Assurance \& Governance**


* Ensure adherence to project governance, SDLC, and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Review functional designs and test cases to ensure completeness and accuracy.
* Support UAT planning, execution, defect triage, and sign\-off.
* Ensure compliance with Salesforce security, data privacy, and access control standards.

### **Change Management \& Adoption**


* Support change management activities including user training, documentation, and rollout planning.
* Ensure smooth transition from project delivery to post\-go\-live support.
* Drive user adoption through effective communication and training initiatives.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**
--------------------------------------


### **Salesforce Functional Skills**


* Strong functional knowledge of Salesforce platform and core features.
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce configuration (Flows, Reports, Dashboards, Security Model).
* Experience working across Salesforce clouds (Sales, Service, Experience; Marketing Cloud is a plus).
* Understanding of Salesforce data model, integrations, and APIs (functional perspective).

### **Project Management Skills**


* Proven experience managing Salesforce or CRM projects.
* Strong knowledge of Agile/Scrum and/or Waterfall project methodologies.
* Experience in risk management, scope control, and resource planning.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

### **Stakeholder \& Communication Skills**


* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and leadership abilities.
* Ability to present project status and functional solutions to senior management.

### **Analytical \& Problem\-Solving Skills**


* Strong analytical skills to translate complex business needs into scalable solutions.
* Proactive problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------


* Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Administrator, Advanced Administrator, or Business Analyst.
* Experience working with system integrators or consulting environments.
* Experience in data migration, system integrations, and enterprise CRM programs.

**Experience Required:**
------------------------


* **10\+ years** of overall experience with **5\+ years** in Salesforce functional or project management roles.

A successful candidate will have an established background in driving a complex program portfolio with considerable impact, program management, problem solving and communication skills and be comfortable interacting with technical and non\-technical stakeholders at all levels. Come be part of this growing, dynamic and challenging space!  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Experience of managing complex business processes at scale.
* Drive end\-to\-end high impact and high visibility programs that impact pricing and hence customer experience on Amazon
* Good on communication and influencing skills with an ability to deal with a fast\-paced environment.
* Experience in defining, developing and using metrics to drive the vision and manage the business.
* Analyze data and dive deep into processes to derive insights for enhancing systems
* Ability to lead not only at the strategic level, but also tactically day\-to\-day by diving deeply into business and technical domains.
* Liaise with tech, product, ops and category teams to ensure timely deliverables for key projects

* Write compelling business documents and drive outcomes for senior leadership at Amazon

------------------------

* 5\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 5\+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
